headline: EA shuts down BioWare, cancels next Mass Effect
summary: EA is shutting down BioWare, the studio behind Mass Effect, Dragon Age and Knights of the Old Republic, and has canceled the next Mass Effect game amid layoffs of 400 staff.

claims.statement: EA is shutting down BioWare, the studio behind Mass Effect, Dragon Age and Knights of the Old Republic.

sources.quote: BioWare, the legendary studio behind RPGs like Mass Effect, Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, is shutting down, the company confirmed in a statement.
RIP BioWare: EA shuts down storied RPG studio after over three decades

claims.statement: EA has canceled the next Mass Effect game that was in development.

sources.quote: Alongside the closure, Electronic Arts has chosen not to continue development on the next Mass Effect game that was in the works, according to an announcement sent
Next Mass Effect project canceled as parent company lays off 400.

claims.statement: The closure is tied to parent company EA laying off 400 employees.

sources.quote: Next Mass Effect project canceled as parent company lays off 400.
